description: This circular diagram, titled “Ever-scalingness” and associated with the paper “Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge An Ever-Scaling Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs,” visually represents four core attributes of the benchmark as equal-sized quadrants arranged around a central point. Each quadrant is labeled with a key property and features a distinct color and icon: the top-left quadrant, labeled “Uncrushable” and colored yellow, represents “Complexity” and includes a ladder icon; the top-right quadrant, labeled “Unhackable” and colored light blue, represents “Instance” and includes a shield icon; the bottom-right quadrant, labeled “General” and colored light green, represents “Coverage” and includes a globe with gears icon; and the bottom-left quadrant, labeled “Auto-verifiable” and colored red, represents “Scalable Oversight” and includes a clipboard with a checkmark icon. The chart does not display numerical percentages or proportions for the segments, nor does it include a legend or percentage labels within the slices. The four quadrants are arranged symmetrically around the center, and none of the slices are visually emphasized or exploded.
